notes.title: More Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello, I'm back with more bug fixes. I'm trying to bring the current state of the game to the highest level possible.

- Fixed the girl running towards us as soon as she spawned in the loop where we had to collect keys.
- Flickering textures fixed.
- Some lighting issues fixed.
- Some sound issues fixed.

If you encounter any bugs or translation errors in the game, please feel free to contact me via X or email.

[b]Have fun![/b]

notes.title: Bugs fixed, menu has been adjusted, and the sound and lighting revised.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, I am so sorry to everyone whose gameplay experience was affected by these bugs. I am developing the game on my own, so sometimes I can't keep up with everything. I truly appreciate your understanding.

- The bug that caused players to get stuck between the door and the wall has been fixed. 
- The game freeze at the left exit in the dark and long loop has been resolved. 
- Some sounds and lighting have been revised. 
- Warnings have been added to the menu. 

If you notice any other bugs or find any issues with the translations, please feel free to contact me via X or email. 

[b]Have fun![/b]
